title: Material Player
settings.enabled.about: The card appears when music or a voice message plays.
settings.paused.about: Otherwise the card hides while the track is paused.
settings.wave.about: A moving wave on the bar while the track plays.
preview.title: Track title
preview.caption: This is how the card looks:
settings.clicks: The buttons and the progress bar work right on the card. The cover opens the chat with the track, the cross hides the card until the next track.
settings.draggable.about: Drag the card anywhere in the window so it does not cover what you need. It remembers the place.
settings.reset_place: Put it back in the corner
toast.reset_place: The player is back in its corner
